territory: Uncertainty in vision/ML: calibration, conformal prediction, epistemic/aleatoric decomposition, selective prediction, uncertainty for dense/pixel tasks and safety-critical vision systems
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields in order (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, core_claim, method_sketch, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, novelty_hook, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, kill_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label). Following the convention of earlier Wave A shards, alias fields mirror their counterparts: core_claim=core_hypothesis, method_sketch=minimal_falsification_experiment, novelty_hook=why_possibly_novel, kill_risk=main_risk. Every candidate states the community default belief, why it might be wrong, and a cheapest/fastest falsifying experiment. The shard was written incrementally in five flushes of 20 lines each and validated for JSON parseability, sequential ids, and field completeness.

compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or experimental results; dataset/model families appear only as proposed experiment subjects and all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows directories created; no Windows numbers changed; only the two mandated files written under Windows16/_state/tasks/P1/.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 100 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard conceptual neighbors were minimized but remain for dedup review: unct-0002 vs unct-0012 (input-conditional temperature vs margin-distribution recalibration), unct-0015 vs unct-0088 (hierarchical shrinkage vs importance-weighted rare-class conformal), unct-0020 vs unct-0024 (feature-distance vs TTA-variance nonconformity scores), unct-0027 vs unct-0031 vs unct-0097 (single-pass epistemic proxies via gradient norm, feature density, and cross-layer probe disagreement), unct-0044 vs unct-0027 (pretext-task signals at test time), unct-0068 vs unct-0087 (severity monotonicity as one dimension of the broader audit suite), unct-0053 vs unct-0093 (variance-based hallucination detection in super-resolution vs diffusion restoration).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-02 medical segmentation (unct-0019, unct-0083, unct-0084), genA-04 object detection (unct-0057..unct-0064, unct-0017), genA-05 VLM dense prediction (unct-0091..unct-0100), genA-06 failure mining (unct-0035, unct-0036, unct-0085), genA-07 benchmark weaknesses (unct-0042, unct-0043, unct-0065, unct-0087), and genA-09 synthetic data (unct-0089, unct-0098); dedup should treat these as high-collision zones.
Human-subject candidates (unct-0016, unct-0084) require small user studies whose ethics-review and recruitment overhead is flagged inside the records but not costed.
Several candidates (unct-0028, unct-0073, unct-0079) require ensemble or variational training at multiple model scales; their fastest-falsifying experiments are scoped-down small-scale pilots.
